text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you. ...Heh, you never fail to 
remember my birthday, do you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The same goes for you, Sis. You'd always 
be the very first to congratulate me the 
second the clock struck midnight.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, how nostalgic. Do you remember the 
handmade present you gave me when you were 
little?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Even now, that is my treasure.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, I remember that look. Those origami 
glasses you folded for me were quite well 
made.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And I was able to put it on properly too. 
Oh right, maybe I'll take it out for the 
first time in a while. It's stored in my 
desk drawer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
That's definitely impossible now. Unlike 
back then, I've gotten way bigger.
